source_citation: Poulain, Gerin, Rixen, Zanasca, Teixeira, Griffa, Molcard, de Marte and Pinardi (2012), Aspects of the surface circulation in the Liguro-Provencal basin and Gulf of Lion as observed by satellite-tracked drifters (2007–2009), Bollettino di Geofisica Teorica ed Applicata 53(2), 261–279, doi:10.4430/bgta0052.
parent_scope_note: The ledger treats Ligurian Current as a Northern Current segment. This studied reach overlaps the broader current geography; do not add its length to the parent or count it as an independent parallel flow.
layer: Surface-flow geography in a study combining CODE drifters following the first metre and ARGOSPHERE drifters following the first 10–20 cm with unquantified wind slip. No full-depth or shelf-break axis diagnosed from the editorial route.
sampling_context: Source drifter sampling is intermittent during May–October 2007 and October 2008–January 2009. The selected reach is editorial geographic context, not one float trajectory, simultaneous observation, annual mean or seasonal path.

additional_width_evidence_pending_defini.source_locator: Section 4, p. 274 and Discussion p. 276; Fig. 9
additional_width_evidence_pending_defini.interpretation: Imperia coast-to-limit range remains unresolved as a width metric. Menton–Nice band is now separately extracted as a local approximately 20 km profile-band span, not paired whole-current width or seasonal margin.

excluded_inferences: No basin-wide recirculation loops added to coastal reach length.
No Corsica feeder path or upstream formation location treated as this gate.
No winter/summer parent widths transferred to local segment.
No broad paper sampling window treated as a continuously observed route.
remaining_gates: Resolve the geographic Ligurian naming convention before whole-segment endpoint admission.
Review source sampling/layer and coastal path with finer bathymetry or compatible current data.
Keep overlapping Northern Current and Ligurian segment lengths separate; do not sum them.
Review local 20 km Menton–Nice profile-band extraction, mixed surface support and remaining Imperia coast-distance limit; no paired whole-current width inferred.
